limitations: finite representative windows, no durable delivery/replay or arbitrary crash safety
client reconnect/replacement performed explicitly by harness
TCP pause is a slow-reader experiment, not a whole-process memory bound or Internet congestion model
same-host POSIX experiment; no multi-host or rolling deployment guarantee
